stopCondition: A row whose decision record says something different from what the retriage claims stops and is reported; the record wins and the retriage is the defect.

stoppedRows.retriageClaim: The cited LD-OR-01 combined route answers the acquittal row as one COURT SET-ASIDE PACKET under ORS 137.225(1)(c)-(d).
stoppedRows.recordEffect: The existing broad route is legally overbroad. Never-charged matters must use a distinct ORS 137.225(1)(c) Option 3 configuration; acquittals must use a distinct ORS 137.225(1)(d) Option 2 configuration; ordinary dismissals must use a separate ORS 137.225(1)(d) Option 2 configuration. The treatments may share one packet family only if each has a distinct governed configuration; they may not resolve to one generic or null packet configuration.
stoppedRows.retriageDefect: The retriage cites the older aggregate LD-OR-01 projection even though the newer counsel record names that same route as overbroad and requires it to be retired, narrowed, or replaced. Emitting a 37-row implementation from the retriage would preserve a superseded Oregon route treatment.
